wz_buiten_dicht_tekst: Cogvivo will then use your location in the background, even when the app is closed or not in use. That’s how the app notices you’re close to a monument you haven’t visited, and sends you a notification that {naam} has gone there. Your location is not stored, not shared and not used for ads.
wz_buiten_dicht_kies: On your phone’s next screen, choose ‘Allow all the time’. You can turn it off any time, here or in your phone’s settings.
